name: Atlas Custom Infrared Sauna
description: SaunaCloud's flagship custom indoor far-infrared sauna, designed to the buyer's room with VantaWave wall heaters, CORE 5 controls, solid Western Red Cedar and optional integrated red light.

source.ref: SaunaCloud official Atlas Custom Infrared Sauna page
source.note: SaunaCloud told Wellness Fit Check to use its public model and specification pages as the current configurations. Each sauna is custom designed and quote-only; dimensions, circuit requirements, room-air temperature and price vary by project and are not inferred.
